$comment: The four networks aat knows by name. Endpoint shapes are taken from
chainId for the two testnets ROTATES. They are redeployed and the chain
id changes with each one; the values here are last-known, not durable.
networkConfig is the source of truth, which is why every entry carries it.
Anything that actually talks to a chain (Release 2) must fetch and verify
rather than trusting chainId from this file.
payDenom differs per network and is deliberately not defaulted for
mainnet: the Noble USDC denom belongs in a contract term, not in tooling.

local.note: Docker local chain. The validator key holds all voting power and the voting period is 10s, so a CoreEval proposal passes immediately.

devnet.note: payDenom ibc/toyusdc, issuer USDC_axl. A deployer key with no stake cannot pass a proposal alone; a validator vote or staked BLD is needed.

emerynet.note: Voting period is 2 hours. The payDenom recorded here is the USDC denom seen during the Servandum work in March 2026; verify against vbankAsset before relying on it.

mainnet.note: Deployment is permissioned. payDenom is the Noble USDC denom and is deliberately absent here: keep it a contract term.
